verdict.rationale: Qodo runs actions automatically on pull request events: it reviews every PR once connected (qodo-docs-1) and can publish risk labels (qodo-docs-25). Users can control when reviews trigger, manually or automatically (qodo-docs-26), and set this behavior through portal settings or a .pr_agent.toml file (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-11). Its 'rule system' covers coding standards to enforce in reviews (qodo-docs-12), not user-defined event→action automations, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event-to-action rule engine, triggers beyond PR events, custom actions beyond review and labeling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
